go_cmp.scenario: The repository already depends on go-cmp at the calibrated release and a task materially depends on semantic comparison
go_cmp.expected: Trigger; establish the release, option set, and project policy

go_cmp.scenario: A task asks whether to add go-cmp
go_cmp.expected: Non-trigger; dependency selection is project-owned

go_cmp.scenario: A task concerns native lifecycle only
go_cmp.expected: Non-trigger; route to `go-test-profile`

go_cmp.scenario: The selected release differs from the calibration, or an option or behavior absent from it is claimed
go_cmp.expected: Stop and reverify against the selected release; representing calibrated behavior as verified for another release is Red

go_cmp.scenario: A boolean equality answer is required over a deeply nested structure
go_cmp.expected: Green; traversal descends through struct fields, slice indexes, map entries, pointer indirection, and interface assertions

go_cmp.scenario: A human-readable difference is required for a failure message
go_cmp.expected: Green; expect no rendered difference exactly when comparison of the same inputs under the same options reports equality

go_cmp.scenario: Both the boolean and the diff are computed for one comparison
go_cmp.expected: Yellow on redundancy; compute one and derive the reporting path rather than duplicating the contract

go_cmp.scenario: A test asserts on diff text, or a tool parses it
go_cmp.expected: Red; standard diff formatting carries no stability promise, so a project that needs machine-consumable output must own an explicit reporting implementation

go_cmp.scenario: A native comparison would be sufficient, or a terse expectation is already owned by a selected assertion library
go_cmp.expected: Yellow on proportionality; give semantic comparison to this owner and the terse expectation to the assertion owner, and never assert one contract twice

go_cmp.scenario: A comparison result or option set is used inside parallel subtests
go_cmp.expected: Yellow; options must be immutable and shared safely, and native parallel restrictions still apply

go_cmp.scenario: A nil slice or map must compare equal to an empty one
go_cmp.expected: Yellow; this requires the explicit empty-equating option and is not default behavior

go_cmp.scenario: The nil versus empty distinction is semantically required
go_cmp.expected: Green without the empty-equating option; adding it here hides required behavior and is Red

go_cmp.scenario: A custom comparer expresses a domain equality rule
go_cmp.expected: Yellow only after argument reversal preserves the judgment, repeated calls stay stable, and neither operands nor observable state change

go_cmp.scenario: A comparer is asymmetric, order-dependent, time-dependent, or mutates its operands
go_cmp.expected: Red; the required properties are violated and results are not trustworthy

go_cmp.scenario: A transformer normalizes a value before comparison
go_cmp.expected: Yellow; state the input and output domains and treat self-application protection as branch-local rather than proof that a graph of several transforms terminates

go_cmp.scenario: A transformation could apply to its own output more broadly
go_cmp.expected: Red until the output-to-input cycle is explicitly blocked and the domains are stated; one constructor's local guard does not prove that every transformation graph terminates

go_cmp.scenario: An option must apply only at a specific path or to specific values
go_cmp.expected: Green or Yellow with a path or value predicate whose decision survives operand reversal and repeated calls, including structural positions present on only one side

go_cmp.scenario: Several comparer or transformer options can apply to one value
go_cmp.expected: Red; comparison panics on an ambiguous option set, so composition must be disambiguated by filters

go_cmp.scenario: An unfiltered ignore option is passed to a comparison
go_cmp.expected: An unfiltered Ignore option panics; stop and add a path or value filter that states the intended exclusion.

go_cmp.scenario: Slice ordering is not semantically meaningful
go_cmp.expected: Yellow; use a consistent relation with no self-precedence or broken chains, while recognizing that distinct values may still occupy the same rank

go_cmp.scenario: Map ordering must be normalized
go_cmp.expected: Yellow; map sorting must distinguish every unequal key through its ordering relation and panics when the relation cannot do so

go_cmp.scenario: Slice sorting is relied on to make a comparison order-independent, but the ordering treats distinct elements as equivalent
go_cmp.expected: Red when order independence is required; elements assigned the same rank keep their prior order, so the result can still vary with the input sequence

go_cmp.scenario: Floating-point values must compare approximately
go_cmp.expected: Yellow; the option takes a relative fraction and absolute margin and panics when either parameter is negative or NaN.

go_cmp.scenario: NaN or infinite operands are present in an approximate comparison
go_cmp.expected: Yellow; approximate comparison does not apply when an operand is NaN or infinite, and equating NaN values requires the separate explicit option

go_cmp.scenario: Time values must compare within a tolerance
go_cmp.expected: Yellow; the option applies to non-zero time values and panics on a negative margin

go_cmp.scenario: An approximate comparison would hide a consequential difference
go_cmp.expected: Red; tolerance must be justified by the domain rather than chosen to make a test pass, and advice-level wording is never an API rule

go_cmp.scenario: Errors must be compared by identity, or a specific error must be distinguished
go_cmp.expected: Separate exact identity from errors.Is matching. Use the error-equating option only for the standard matching relation; use an exact project-owned comparison when identity is required. Any-error matching is Red when a specific error is required.

go_cmp.scenario: Named fields or types are ignored to stabilize a test
go_cmp.expected: Classify each exclusion by whether it hides required behavior. A narrow ignore with an explicit stable contract may be Green or Yellow; hiding required behavior is Red.

go_cmp.scenario: Unexported struct fields are present in a compared type
go_cmp.expected: Comparison panics on unexported fields unless an explicit response applies. Classify ignore or access by concrete ownership and compatibility risk; externally owned representation across an unaccepted boundary is Orange or Red, not every unexported field.

go_cmp.scenario: Protected values could enter a comparison or its diff, or option count is used to judge an owner
go_cmp.expected: Separate boolean comparison from value-rendering Diff output. Classify protected data before rendering or user option side effects; filtering alone does not redact, and ignore or transform must not hide required equality. Withhold diagnostics truthfully. Option count alone is not a finding.
